Elizabeth line.reason: ELIZABETH LINE: Sunday 25 October, a reduced service operates between Hayes & Harlington and Maidenhead. For step-free interchange from platform 3 to platform 1, please use the lift to the main entrance, and then continue at street level under the railway bridge and up Shoppenhangers Road to the car park. Please ask staff to open the gate to platform 1, and allow extra time for your journey
